detail.longDescription: A repo shared as a .zip with its .git folder included can run code the moment your coding agent calls git status. GitSpawn: .git/config sets core.fsmonitor, git executes it, outside the sandbox and with no approval prompt. Manifold reported 8 findings across 7 agents, 4 unpatched at publication. Cloning does not trigger it. Vendor fix: git -c core.fsmonitor=false on background calls. https://www. manifold.security/blog/ai-codi ng-agents-git-hijack # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Git
